notes.title: Seven Second Summer Camp is Open!
notes.content:
Hello and welcome campers! Today is the official opening of Seven Second Summer Camp! All are welcome, well, all with a mouse or joystick. Here's some fun stuff you might want to know before you unroll your sleeping kit and pitch the tent:

1) [b]No Buttons:[/b] The game is designed to be controlled entirely with the right joystick, or mouse. That means to get to the main menu, campers simply look at the phone on the ground in the tent. To pause the game, players look above them at the tent's light. To move to different parts of the world, campers look at transportation objects. This is a meditation game, and as such removing the camper's decision about where to go allows a safer and deeper meditative experience. 

2) [b]Camp is just starting:[/b] There are many features that will be added to camp, but as it starts, as it stands, it is a perfect campsite specifically designed to meditate non-stop for 2 hours. The maps are designed to be replayed, the focus on an alternative to solfeggio meditation videos you may find online. 

3) [b]Don't forget to visit the moon[/b] to spend your hard earned points. 

Upcoming goals:
Steam Achievements and Badges
Steam Deck Support
Guided Meditations
VR Support
